location_exception_reason: PVC Toilets are mass-produced portable sanitation units sold nationwide; location of manufacture or seller does not change the product's functional identity or buyer decision calculus. GI-tagged or regional-origin exception does not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor) are redundant in PVC Toilet titles — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'PVC Toilet Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title; the business relationship is not part of what is being sold.
